newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia BTC says seeks fresh capital.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia BTC says seeks fresh capital.

text.p: Slovenian warehouse and shopping centre operator BTC said on Tuesday it was seeking fresh capital in order to finance new investments and was mulling an option of issuing global depositary receipts.

"The management suggested that the capital of the company be enlarged by up to 2.4 billion tolars ($15.5 million) or 50 percent of the current capital in order for us to be able to finance further development," said Helena Petrin, BTC's general secretary.
BTC has already held talks with potential foreign and domestic investors but has not yet determined how to conduct the capital increase, she said.
"The decision on how to raise the capital will be taken only after the plan to raise it is confirmed at the shareholders' meeting on April 29," Petrin said.
One option would be to issue global depositary receipts (GDR), she said.

On Tuesday BTC shares, which are listed on the main market of the Ljubljana bourse, surged 6.44 percent to 14,370 tolars on market rumours of a possible GDR issue in the next six months, traders said.
